_about: CurseForge gallery for 1.1.0, in upload order. Graphics are made by art/source/gallery.py; shots/ are real CI screenshots (Gallery screenshots workflow) picked by art/source/pick_shots.py.
mod: See exactly what killed you: every hit from your last 10 seconds, and what your armor blocked.
Die, click the skull button on the death screen, and read every hit. Press K to see it again.
One row per hit: time, who hit you, damage type, damage, what armor and enchantments blocked, and health left.
Armor and each Protection enchantment are counted separately, hit by hit, from the game's own math.
Your last 5 deaths, a settings screen, /db history and /db help.
Forge 1.12.2 to 26.3 and NeoForge 1.20.1 to 26.3. Players without the mod still get the chat recap.
A zombie with an iron sword and a skeleton attack on a Superflat world.
A short fall, an arrow and five sword hits, with what iron armor and Protection III blocked.
Every lava tick, with what Fire Protection IV stopped.
A fall, then the final blow from a creeper. Press < to flip back to earlier deaths.
Point at a row to see every number for that hit.
After each death you also get a short summary in chat.
Every option on one screen, each with a tooltip. Open it from the recap or the Mods list.
Your last 5 deaths, kept after you leave. Click one to open it.
The reopen key is K by default. Change it in Controls under Death Breakdown.

A clean summary first, then one page per hit with every number.
Death history, a tip line, [copy] and /db help.
